title: Interactive Library Directory
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: INTERACTIVE LIBRARY DIRECTORY
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Ordered lines, consistent pointers, normal end marker, byte-identical audio variants; runtime untested
versions.unavailableReason: Another recovered save; the site offers one selected player.
versions.startupSource:
20 L=0
30 DIM E(10):'MAX # OF SHELFS THAT A (SUB)SECTION CAN BE ON
90 CLS:RESTORE:R=0
95 CLS:PRINT"PRESS THE LETTER OF THE AREA YOU WISH TO INVESTIGATE":PRINT
100 READ A$:IF A$="U"  THEN R=R+1ELSEIFA$="D"THEN R=R-1
110 IF R>L THEN200
120 IF L=R AND A$<>"U" AND A$<>"D"THEN LZ=LZ+1:PRINTCHR$(LZ+64)" ) ";:IF RIGHT$(A$,1)=")"THENGOSUB260:PRINT A$ELSEPRINTA$
130 GOTO 100
200 PRINT:PRINT"YOUR CHOICE ? ";
202 C$=INKEY$:IFC$=""THEN202
203 IFC$<"A"OR ASC(C$)>LZ+64 THEN 202ELSEPRINTC$;
205 C=ASC(C$)-64
